node.statement: Put R:=max_{1<=i<=r} sum_{j=1}^s |B_ij|. For any x in R^s with ||x||_infinity<=1, each |x_j|<=1, so for every row i the triangle inequality gives |(Bx)_i|=|sum_j B_ij x_j|<=sum_j |B_ij||x_j|<=sum_j |B_ij|<=R. Taking the maximum over i and then the supremum over the l-infinity unit ball yields ||B||_{infinity->infinity}<=R. All comparisons are non-strict (for B=[1] and x=(1), each is equality). Conversely, because r>=1 is finite, choose i_0 attaining R and set x_j=1 when B_(i_0 j)>=0 and x_j=-1 otherwise. Since s>=1, ||x||_infinity=1, while (Bx)_(i_0)=sum_j |B_(i_0 j)|=R; hence ||B||_{infinity->infinity}>=||Bx||_infinity>=R. Thus ||B||_{infinity->infinity}=R, including the case R=0.
